ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Left` and `Right`. Each is a fresh copy of `PushSwitch`, starting in its own `Off`.
`left` is wired to the first copy's `press`, and `leftLamp` to its `lit`: the left lamp comes on. The right copy is unaffected.
The right copy switches on `rightLamp`. The two copies run side by side, each in its own region.
The left copy is in its `On` state and switches off. The right copy stays `On`.
